messages:
Chris Nguyen: Quick preflight for the perf sprint — agenda: 1) CI flakes blocking kernel e2e, 2) KV eviction regression, 3) continuous-batching canary timing. Owners please ack and share short status.

Maya Patel: ack. CI flakes — failing on `kernel-shard-teardown` test intermittently. I found a race in the test harness. Will push a fix + flaky skip in ~2h. Link PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/1123 :eyes:

Rahul Sinha: KV eviction regression — saw increased miss rate on small instance types after last allocator change. I have a repro script and heap profile, posting in #eng-runtime later.

Samira Ortiz: Continuous-batching canary — we planned to run the canary tomorrow 09:00 PDT with 10% traffic. Need owners for rollback playbook and monitoring dashboards. I'm happy to run rollbacks.

Chris Nguyen: rollback playbook — can you paste the short steps? also need the metric thresholds for auto-safety.

Samira Ortiz: Rollback quick steps:
1) `kubectl scale deploy runtime-canary --replicas=0`
2) switch route in `router` to stable
3) revert iap image tag in infra
Metrics: p99 > 1200ms for 3m or error-rate > 0.5% triggers auto-roll

Ava Li: I'll add traces and KV hit-rate panel to the canary dashboard. ETA 1h.

DevOps Bot: incident-check: canary-sla will be created at 2026-03-18T09:00:00Z. Reminder will post 30m prior.

Maya Patel: PR for test harness -> merged to staging. Running full e2e now. :thumbsup:

Rahul Sinha: posted repro + heap profiles in thread: https://go/repro-123. Also added a small mitigation patch, need review from @Maya.

Maya Patel: reviewing now, will attempt optimized tearDown sequence.

Chris Nguyen: Great. Quick asks:
- Rahul, please add a short note listing which instance SKUs are affected
- Samira, confirm ops on-call for rollback
- Ava, ping when dashboard is up

Samira Ortiz: I'm on-call tomorrow morning, will own rollback. :white_check_mark:

Ava Li: dashboard up: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/abc123/canary-kv-batching (panels: latency, kv-hit, eviction, error-rate)

Chris Nguyen: Awesome. We'll regroup async in this thread — if anything blocks, ping #eng-oncall. Thanks team :pray:
